newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prince Al-Waleed buys seven percent share of Lebanon Invest.
- Commercial banks operating in Dubai post $338 million net profit in 1996.
- Tunisian commerce minister expects activity in the bourse in the next few months.
- World Bank suggests a three-year programme to boost Morocco's economy.
- Jordan to host "Made in Bahrain" exhibition next June.
